name: com.eltrabajito/directory
title: El Trabajito directory
description: Costa Rica directory of independent workers with ratings and reviews. Read-only search and profiles.

tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Search the directory of independent workers and small businesses in Costa Rica (gardeners, painters, plumbers, electricians, cleaners, bakers, mechanics and more). Results are ranked by customer rating, then by number of reviews. Pass a free-text query ("panadera", "plumber"), optionally a category slug from list_categories, a place name, a minimum rating or kind. Always include the profile url when you recommend someone.

query.description: What the person needs, in Spanish or English.

category.description: Category slug from list_categories, for example "painting".

place.description: Town or area, for example "Santa Ana" or "Heredia".

minRating.description: Only return profiles whose average rating is at least this many stars (0 to 5). Unrated profiles are excluded when it is above 0. Default 0.

kind.description: Restrict to individual workers (person) or companies (business). Leave out for both.

language.description: Language of the names and links in the answer (default es).

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Full public profile of one worker or business: about, services, service area, how to contact them (phone, WhatsApp, email, website, social pages), payment methods, rating and a link to the page. Give the slug from search_businesses.

slug.description: The profile slug, exactly as returned by search_businesses or top_rated (for example "carlos-jimenez").

language.description: Language of the names and links in the answer (default es).

tools.name: get_business_reviews
tools.description: Customer reviews of one profile, newest first (rating, text, date, first name and initial). Reviews are written by signed-in users; the directory does not verify that the reviewer hired the person.

slug.description: The profile slug, exactly as returned by search_businesses or top_rated (for example "carlos-jimenez").

page.description: Page of reviews, newest first, starting at 1 (default 1).

language.description: Language of the names and links in the answer (default es).

tools.name: top_rated
tools.description: The best-rated profiles in a category, optionally in one area, ranked by average rating and then by number of reviews: the answer to "who is a good X in Y". Unrated profiles come last and say so.

place.description: Area name; only areas with at least three profiles are listed separately, otherwise all of the category is returned.

limit.description: How many profiles to return, up to 10 (default 5).

language.description: Language of the names and links in the answer (default es).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every category that has at least one live profile, grouped, with the number of profiles and the slug to use in the other tools.

language.description: Language of the names and links in the answer (default es).
